correctness.rationale: Smoothness in characteristics zero and seven follows from the explicit partial derivatives. The ternary Hessian is exactly \(54Z(8X^3Y^2-2X^2Z^3-Y^5)\); exact lex elimination yields the affine ideal with \(P(x)=729x^{18}-270x^9-2\), which is squarefree. The origin contributes weight two, four infinity points weight one, and eighteen affine roots weight one, exhausting degree 24. Modulo seven, \(\overline P=x^{18}+3x^9+5\) satisfies \(x^{7^{18}}\equiv x\) and the two gcd conditions for exponents \(7^9\) and \(7^6\). Rabin irreducibility gives a degree-eighteen closed point and a Frobenius eighteen-cycle.
